correctness.rationale: Complementation relates super domination to an external private-neighbor witness for every vertex in the complement, and the latter property is hereditary: deleting selected vertices leaves old witnesses external and private. Thus maximality is tested by single additions. A private witness is decided within distance two; adding a vertex changes status only within distance two, so checking old feasibility and testing an addition require a radius-four window. A sentinel is never a witness but correctly represents the absence of its other neighbor. The four appended sentinels complete the last ordinary positions; no artificial vertex is tested, giving one empty word at n=0. The fixed binary extension is linear on all suffix vectors, as is the fixed end functional. The independent replay, python3 -B /workspace/evidence/check_3.py, verified the critical exact coordinate identity at 18 on the union of 111 states, the early scalar identities from 12 to 18, and all numerator coefficients. Applying the same extension to the zero vector and then closing proves the recurrence for every n>=18; the smaller checked indices close the gap. Independently testing graph-level subsets agreed at n=0..15, corroboration rather than extrapolation. The result counts labeled path subsets without size refinement, not minimum-cardinality sets or reversal orbits.

originality.rationale: Distinctness from a material exact same-day overlap is not established. The upper-super-domination record 5a93dfe1022b does not merely report an extremal value. Its Proof §§1–2 fully specify a finite acceptor, in bijection with every configuration in this census for n>=2. The target OGF is the unweighted length specialization of that exact acceptor. Converting a known finite autonomous acceptor to its length generating function is a mechanical matrix calculation. The verified reduced numerator and recurrence are useful computations, but do not supply a new enumeration condition or boundary model beyond that alphabet, initial state and terminal test. This is an exact mathematical implication, not an assertion that either same-day record was published first, and not a finding that the path formula is false. The cycle and forest comparisons alone would not justify this verdict.
residual_risks: No ordering or direction of derivation is established between same-day records. The fail is for lack of a supported distinct mathematical increment, not a historical priority determination.
The 2008 irredundance full text and unindexed equivalent terminology remain unresolved historical risks.

value.rationale: Minimal-set counts on a natural graph family are useful, and a reduced recurrence makes them convenient to compute. But the exact boundary-sensitive acceptor for the same paths already gives the whole sequence by unweighted transfer, so this record's scope does not establish a further worthwhile exact invariant beyond its mechanical evaluation. No cardinality refinement, new structural description, or other distinct mathematical result is established here. The negative judgment is about the incremental contribution over the stronger acceptor, not about the independent correctness check.
